bio: I’m Liam, a mechatronics engineer with 6+ years in surgical and construction robotics, based in Bergen, Norway.
I work full time as a Senior Mechatronics Engineer at Rockslice, where I was the first engineering hire and build explosive-free robotic rock and concrete cutting.
Alongside that I am pursuing an industrial PhD through NTNU’s Field Robotics Lab, in partnership with Rockslice, on advanced control and material sensing for the cutting platform.

Before that I was a mechanical engineer at Ethicon (formerly Auris), working on Johnson & Johnson’s Ottava surgical robot, and I hold an M.Sc. in Mechatronics from MCI Innsbruck and a B.Sc. in Aerospace Engineering from Cal Poly San Luis Obispo.
